name: hudu-mcp
description: Every Hudu cmdlet, plus an offline SQLite mirror, cross-entity audits, and agent-native output no PowerShell module or read-only MCP ships.

hudu_api_key.title: HUDU_API_KEY
hudu_api_key.description:
Raw Hudu API key sent as the `x-api-key` header (no Bearer prefix). Create it in
the Hudu portal: Admin -> API Keys. Keys may be global or company-scoped; company-scoped keys cannot
call the global `assets list` endpoint (use `assets list-by-company`).

hudu_base_url.title: HUDU_BASE_URL
hudu_base_url.description:
Your Hudu instance's API base URL, including the /api/v1 path, e.g.
https://your-subdomain.huducloud.com/api/v1 (self-hosted, *.huducloud.com, or a custom domain).

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

hudu_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
hudu_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

hudu_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
hudu_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

hudu_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
hudu_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Hudu requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

hudu_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
hudu_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
